author: TruthfulGamerAK
quote: This game is awful, rarely a game. I see a lot of people stating this game is getting review bombed. The game is just garbage and isn't self aware. Example; *spoiler* Early in the game you are forced to play a game on the games console and it parodies slow moving games in first person view that asks you to explore and interact with items... Not 5 minutes later you are walking around the house and pressing RT and then scrolling your right stick in order to paint or hammer / screw items in to your house for over 10 MINUTES. The game prioritised detail over gameplay, another example of this, I was attacked by an NPC, fought back, KO'd the guy, then went to pick up the hat my character was wearing and accidentally looted the guy because the hat was on not of him and it prioritised looting. You then end up with the police on you, and have to get around them to change your shirt, vehicle and haircut in order to get back to where you were, which is where the mission is. Just an all around waste of ****'s like if you asked AI to add in the most mundane thing and slow all the pacing out of the fun of Grand Theft Auto games. I blame Red Dead Redemption for its god awful "walk, hold a trigger then press a button to interact with another character". Don't even het me started on the phone. You'll spend 50% of your time outside of doing the trigger and stick chores looking at the phone in order to advance a story whilst in the middle of another activity that is actually **** mind boggles as to why people are rating this game so highly. Crimson Desert, Gears Of War E-Day, Final Fantasy Rebirth are all infinitely better. This game might MIGHT beat of FC27 as fun... The bar is non-existant but for some reason the cattle love this walk and life simulator.

author: TruthfulGamerAK
quote:
This game is awful, to call it a game feels like an insult to video games. I see a lot of people stating this game is getting review bombed. The game is just garbage and isn't self aware. Example; *spoiler* Early in the game you are forced to play a game on the games console and it parodies slow moving games in first person view that asks you to explore and interact with items... Not 5 minutes later you are walking around the house and pressing R2 and then scrolling your right stick in order to paint or hammer / screw items in to your house for over 10 MINUTES.

The game prioritised detail over gameplay, another example of this, I was attacked by an NPC, fought back, KO'd the guy, then went to pick up the hat my character was wearing and accidentally looted the guy because the hat was on not of him and it prioritised looting. You then end up with the police on you, and have to get around them to change your shirt, vehicle and haircut in order to get back to where you were, which is where the mission is. Just an all around waste of time.

It's like if you asked AI to add in the most mundane thing and slow all the pacing out of the fun of Grand Theft Auto games. I blame Red Dead Redemption for its god awful "walk, hold a trigger then press a button to interact with another character". Don't even het me started on the phone. You'll spend 50% of your time outside of doing the trigger and stick chores looking at the phone in order to advance a story whilst in the middle of another activity that is actually fun.

The mind boggles as to why people are rating this game so highly. Crimson Desert, Gears Of War E-Day, Final Fantasy Rebirth are all infinitely better. This game might MIGHT beat of FC27 as fun... The bar is non-existant but for some reason the cattle love this walk and life simulator.
